summary: Dera Ghazi Khan Airport (DEA/OPDG) is a medium-sized domestic airport serving the city of Dera Ghazi Khan in southwestern Punjab, Pakistan. Named after the historical Baloch chieftain Ghazi Khan who founded the city, the airport provides a vital air link for a region known for its proximity to the Sulaiman Mountain Range and the rugged terrain of western Pakistan. The facility primarily handles scheduled domestic flights connecting the area with major Pakistani cities.
faqs:
Q: What airlines operate at Dera Ghazi Khan Airport?
A: Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) is the primary carrier operating scheduled domestic flights to and from Dera Ghazi Khan Airport, typically connecting with Karachi and other major cities.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a medium-sized regional airport, it offers standard passenger amenities including a terminal building, basic waiting areas, and ground transportation options, though services are more limited compared to larger international airports.

Q: Where is Dera Ghazi Khan located?
A: The city sits in the southwestern part of Punjab province, near the border with Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, at the foot of the Sulaiman Mountains along the Indus River.

Q: Is the airport open 24 hours?
A: The airport operates during scheduled flight hours only, so travelers should confirm their flight times in advance as the facility typically closes between flights.
transport_tips: The airport is located a short drive from central Dera Ghazi Khan, with taxis and rickshaws readily available outside the terminal for transport into the city. Pre-arranging a ride through a hotel or local contact is recommended, especially for late arrivals, as ride-hailing apps have limited availability in the region. Car rental services are not widely available at the airport, so ground transport is typically arranged upon arrival.
local_tip: Carry bottled water and sun protection year-round — Dera Ghazi Khan is one of the hottest regions in Pakistan, with summer temperatures regularly exceeding 45°C (113°F), and the airport offers limited shade or climate-controlled waiting areas.
